name: Melodic techno
key_tendency: Minor keys with i-VI-III-VII movement (D minor: Dm Bb F C); emotional, cinematic.
signature: Rolling offbeat bass that follows the chord root
Wide supersaw pad with slow attack
Arpeggio built from the chord tones, an octave up, with delay
Long breakdowns where the pad and arp carry the track
listen_for: The arp and the bass follow the same 4-chord cycle, so the harmony feels like it is lifting every bar. In the breakdown the kick disappears and the pad swells.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("<d2 bb1 f1 c2>").struct("[~ x x x]*4").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(600).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.45)
parts.chords:
const chords = chord("<Dm Bb F C>").voicing().s("supersaw")
  .attack(0.4).release(0.8).lpf(1500).room(0.7).gain(0.18)
parts.lead:
const lead = chord("<Dm Bb F C>").voicing().arp("0 1 2 3 2 1 0 2").add(note(12)).s("triangle")
  .decay(0.2).sustain(0).delay(0.4).delaytime(0.36).delayfeedback(0.5).gain(0.25)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [16, stack(drums, bass.mask("<0 1>/8"))],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords.lpf(800))],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(drums, bass)],
)
